verdict.rationale: Notte documents a public REST API reference that requires Bearer-token authentication and exposes endpoints such as agent start. Through that API you can create cloud browser sessions, scrape pages and run web agents. Sessions are programmatically controllable, expose a CDP endpoint, and scripts can be deployed as invocable API endpoints. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed candidate paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.
